title: The history of Minecraft
text: Minecraft began as a small project. In 2009, a Swedish programmer called Markus Persson, known as Notch, made the first version in only six days. He put it on the internet and people loved it.
At first the game was very simple. There were no monsters and no goals. Players just built things with blocks. Notch worked on the game every day and added new ideas from the players.
In 2011 the full version came out. Notch and his friends started a company called Mojang. The game grew very fast and soon millions of people played it.
In 2014 Microsoft bought Mojang for two and a half billion dollars. Notch left the company, but the game kept growing. It came to phones, consoles and schools.
Today Minecraft is the best-selling video game in history. It sold more than three hundred million copies. Teachers use it to teach maths and history, and there was even a Minecraft film in 2025.
